scope: Post-hoc descriptive comparison of frozen M9 and current M13 on existing COV. No new unrelated dataset, DEV6, final six, reserved or LoTTE access. No paid compute.
metric: Existing equal-family COV nDCG@10 macro; full admitted queries and document candidates
caveats: COV was used for M13 recipe selection and is not fresh validation.
Frozen M9 trained before COV rescreening; overlap protection differs, so this is not a causal recipe comparison.
Current M13 is an intermediate checkpoint; M9 is final, with different doses.
One point difference is diagnostic; no automatic early-stop threshold or round-two authorization.
M9 diagnostic executes CPU fp32; current M13 COV ran on CUDA. This is not a precision-parity experiment.
